real_defects.issue: repairInvoice (the page's Repair button, server /repair, repair-cli) kept its own arithmetic and rewrote invoices checkInvoice passes into failing ones: unit price rounded to cents before multiplying (1000 x 0.125 -> 130.00, not 125.00), price_base_quantity ignored (10 x 50 per 100 -> 500.00, not 5.00), VAT summed per line instead of per rate (BR-CO-17; 3 x 0.10 at 5% -> 0.03, not 0.02), totals.rounding dropped from due, and a negative tax written when a line allowance exceeds the line. Fixed: rewrite a value only when checkInvoice flags it, using linenet.mjs helpers; stop the totals on a negative line net. 9 new tests fail on the old code, including a 300-case seeded fuzz.
